items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: So that's why I got real, you know, good acquainted with Louis on that night.

ctx.x: You think that was more work than the musicians?

Well, yeah, they had more work than they had musicians for the work. See? We had plenty of work to do, but a little money. And I guess it was that we had with all kinds of business then. Plenty of work you had to do with money. But that gave me, what I said, it gave you a chance to play with these brothers. I played with Louis Armstrong in the Tuxedo Band, Parade Band. That was with Papa Celestein. I know you knew him. Oh yeah, I know him. It was his band. I played with Hank Heath and Louis Armstrong. See, I…
What trumpet players did you ever think were the best from him? Huh?
